escena: SCENE: Nexa stands in a bright studio with a pale plaster wall, chest-up medium close-up, her head and shoulders square to the camera, looking straight into the lens with a steady, intense gaze, at the instant she finishes a sentence. Soft window light from the left with gentle fill. 85mm lens at f/2, camera at about 2 m at eye height.
